title: G1 same-class observation and session_update payload audit

summary.scope: Report-only baseline producer/payload audit for existing G1; no new issue numbering and no non-G1 repairs.
primary_non_g1_findings: effort: snapshot has real producers, every Rust session_update shape omits it; Go model detection emits it.
subscription_name: Rust DTO/emitter exists, snapshot name has no non-test assignment, so name is never filled.
conditional_or_lower_impact_findings: transcript_grew_at: populated, but transcript growth alone emits no session_update and Rust source signal differs.
route: populated after model changes, but native explicit-model registration omits Go fallback inference.
first_message/last_message: populated and sent by confirmed input; lower-impact model-update packet-shape difference only, because the UI preserves absent summaries.
limits: Static source/caller inspection only; no runtime reachability claim, builds, tests, provider interaction, source/document edits inside checkout, Git/Cargo operations or formal review of the concurrent G1 change.
Source snapshot binds pristine pre-G1 public bec576-equivalent tree; owner confirmed no edits before capture.
All 48 fields exist in Rust DTO schema. Identified gaps concern population, publication or payload shape.
Ordinary omitempty omissions, shared defaults, bounded provider support and superseded historical Relays findings are not counted as new implementation gaps.
Branch, project_id, git_checked, git_files, git_added and git_deleted are inventoried but repair/acceptance is owned by G1 implementation.
Startup performance is excluded; no blanket implementation-complete or acceptance claim.

metadata.audit: G1 same-class missing producer audit; SessionObservation half
metadata.evidence: static source/caller trace only; no builds/tests/providers/Git changes/production edits
metadata.read_only_scope: All source evidence refers to the captured baseline, not concurrent G1 changes.

variants.status: Enum constructor test-only; behavior source-wired through direct input path
variants.impact: Not a missing first/last-message producer. Confirmed UI input updates snapshot.first_message/last_message and summary_update sends them. The dormant enum handler instead calls update_message, which lacks first/last fields; that handler is not the normal producer. Numeric-only last-message and /clear rules are implemented directly.
variants.limits: Does not assert every native-terminal input is observed; Go handleInput is likewise the UI pty_input path. No new dynamic test executed.

variants.status: Absent baseline producer; G1-owned missing production wiring
variants.impact: Fresh sessions initialize git_root=None and branch/project_id default empty. Only this unused handler assigns branch/git_root; reattach merely copies old values. No baseline branch refresher or project_id computation was found. Go refreshes branch, change counts and stable project identity. Owner is implementing G1 separately; this report is baseline evidence.
variants.limits: No post-G1 code review or acceptance claim. git_root is not itself a session_update JSON field.

variants.status: Enum constructor test-only; behavior source-wired through registration/output detection
variants.impact: Model and effort do have production state producers. Do not label both absent from an enum-constructor search. Separate payload audit identifies effort omitted from session_update and a conditional initial-route gap.
variants.limits: Registration, initial banner and output-change source paths are traced; this is not provider execution or complete detection-format parity proof.

variants.status: Source-wired enum producer; supplemental growth-publication/source divergence
variants.impact: Production polling parses provider transcript and publishes path/agent-session-id/safe-offset/grew_at observation. Consumer changes native path, marker source and growth clock, then only notifies TranscriptChanged. Go separately stats transcript bytes plus subagent mtime and immediately broadcasts growth. Rust activity_update can later carry the clock, so this field is populated, not globally absent.
variants.limits: Do not infer runtime provider coverage merely because enum producer exists. Parser/page/poll state remains bounded and failure paths can skip an iteration.

variants.impact: Claude output queues VT work; periodic collector composes VT/journal/task-detail progress and applies turn-guarded observations. Consumer retains workflow and emits workflow_progress plus CoreEvent::WorkflowChanged. No missing-constructor finding.
variants.limits: Claude-only VT gating is explicit in Go and Rust, not a newly found unsupported-provider omission. This does not prove every parser branch or timer behavior.

variants.impact: Confirmed-turn GitTurnCapture or Reattached events arm native polling. Registry adapter selects Claude/Codex/Grok parser, changed tree produces turn-guarded observation; consumer retains nonempty tree and emits subagent_tree. No missing-constructor finding.
variants.limits: Adapter-key dispatch is intentionally bounded by the registry and implemented readers; presence is not proof of all native data shapes. Config-disabled/terminal/no-path/no-change paths correctly produce none.

variants.status: Enum constructor absent; behavior source-wired through direct completion paths
variants.impact: Output DONE markers call publish_completion directly; native Codex completion takes the routine or Git-gated path; standby fallback is Git-gated. publish_completion retains done and emits done_summary and events. No missing-completion producer finding.
variants.limits: No SessionObservation::Done constructor anywhere in baseline source/tests, but direct publication is sufficient source evidence against a blanket feature-absence claim. Work predicates and provider behavior not newly executed.

variants.status: Enum constructor test-only; behavior source-wired through direct VT observation
variants.impact: Claude orchestration output detects receiver-side header and directly records masked sender/text on conductor, deduplicated and capped at 50, then emits session_update. The enum has no production constructor despite feature being wired.
variants.limits: Bodies are not copied; bounded header observation matches Go design. Do not describe test constructors as production.

variants.status: Source-wired enum producer; historical missing-owner documentation superseded
variants.impact: Relay transition/finish save builds sorted parent statuses from attached relay metadata and applies Relays, then sends returned effects. Consumer replaces snapshot.relays and emits session_update. No current missing-constructor finding.
variants.limits: BEHAVIOR-MATRIX.md:27-41 preserves old missing-Relays finding under explicitly superseded history; lines 9-11 record source closure. Audit does not re-accept full relay lifecycle or external providers.

variants.impact: Queue/progress/flush paths call pending_flag, which compares current value, constructs observation and applies effects. Consumer stores flag and emits session_update. No missing-constructor finding.
variants.limits: State-dependent publication is intentional; enum existence alone would not establish this, but call sites and normal Hub owner startup are present.
